verdict.rationale: E2B's quickstart shows a single `Sandbox.create()` SDK call that returns a live sandbox, ready for code execution, commands and filesystem access. The sandboxes are documented as isolated Firecracker microVMs. On speed, the docs claim templates give 'fully configured sandboxes with running processes ready to use with zero wait time', and the CLI offers `e2b sandbox create` as well. Missing for 10: a concrete documented cold-start latency figure for a default `create()`, and independent or hands-on confirmation of startup speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds

citations.quote: const sbx = await Sandbox.create() // Creates a persistent sandbox session
your agent's code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM instead of your server
This gives you fully configured sandboxes with running processes ready to use with zero wait time for your users.
E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
